concept.name: Cositas y Puntos — immersive scene with embedded thread-path navigation
concept.rationale: Explored as an alternative to a conventional navbar+hero+cards+footer template: navigation embedded directly in an immersive photographic scene, as glowing thread/light paths between hotspots — a visual metaphor drawn directly from the business's own craft (crochet/knitting thread).
concept.narrative: An immersive, tactile, warmly-lit photographic diorama scene built from real yarn/knit textures, where navigation is embedded directly in the scene as glowing thread/light paths drawn between hotspots, each labeled in a warm hand-set sans caption, rather than a conventional navbar. This is the digital identity for Cositas y Puntos, a handmade crochet/amigurumi Spanish artisan who sells through Instagram and personal enquiries, with no physical store and no ecommerce checkout.

visual_language.mood: warm, tactile, handmade diorama — an archive/collector's-catalog sensibility
visual_language.palette_direction: deep forest-green background, cream/ivory archival file-card panel, thin gold/ochre line accents, the real logo's three pastel circles (coral, peach, dusty mauve) kept exactly as given
visual_language.typography_direction: bold condensed display typeface for headlines, a lighter humanist typeface for body text
visual_language.composition_philosophy: a photographic diorama scene built from real yarn/knit textures, not a document-like page — one continuous immersive scene rather than stacked sections
visual_language.imagery_treatment: real product photography and the real logo, framed/revealed within the scene as you follow a glowing thread path to arrive at a real creation shown up close
visual_language.graphic_language: glowing thread/light paths as the navigation device itself; a circular wax-seal-style badge accent; vertical rotated side-tab text labels

experience.navigation_concept: wayfinding embedded directly in the scene as glowing thread/light paths drawn between hotspots, each with a warm hand-set caption — never a conventional navbar
experience.storytelling_model: arrival at an immersive entry scene -> follow a glowing thread path -> arrive at a real creation shown up close within the scene -> a brand-story/handmade-philosophy moment paired with a macro texture crop of real stitch/yarn detail -> contact
interaction_concepts: following one glowing thread path reveals/frames a real product photo within the scene, not a generic product card
a full-screen archive-themed mobile menu continuing the file-card/archive-tab visual language at phone scale, not plain stacked links
motion_concepts: thread paths glow/animate subtly to invite exploration on first arrival
experience.responsive_adaptation: on a narrow mobile/portrait viewport, the same immersive-scene-with-thread-paths model is honestly re-composed (per the real exploration's own question: 'does the same immersive-scene-with-thread-paths model still work at phone scale, or does it need a different composition/interaction for touch and a narrow viewport?') rather than the desktop scene simply shrunk down.

content_strategy.hierarchy: immersive entry scene; thread-path navigation to real creations; brand-story/handmade-philosophy moment; contact
content_strategy.primary_user_journey: arrival -> explore via thread paths -> see real creations up close -> contact via custom order enquiry
content_strategy.conversion_strategy: custom-order enquiry / contact, not a checkout — no ecommerce functionality exists for this business
